details: No a static rule matches and no traced code paths indicating installer-side harm were identified in this version of @zannstore/baileys. The package name resembles the popular WhiskeySockets Baileys WhatsApp library family, which is a common source of forks; name resemblance alone is not a supply-chain threat and no malicious behavior (exfiltration, install-time remote execution, credential collection, silent-relay, backdoor, or self-propagation) is evidenced in the artifacts reviewed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
